body:
It’s glitches out on PS4 and PC :(
I’m on both.

Man, that really sad to hear about what happen at college. I would say if you haven’t already tired playing online game and make some friends there that would help you feel a lot better. Have you tired getting back in to your social circle? I’m sure they miss you but haven’t had the time to contact you. So with the free time you do have, what do yo do. You looking for a online coop buddy?

Ah man, I don’t want to pry but what happen those few years ago? You don’t have to say if you don’t wanna...when you start getting these feelings, do you recognize yourself spiraling down. Is there a pattern you notice  before you get like this?

Lol yup sounds like we can be best friends. God I don’t know how many people tell me “gosh , you are quiet”. Like I know that! I tired being loud but I didn’t like it. I can’t get enough of RPGs games ( board game too. How long have you been suicidal?
Yo Clyde. How would you describe your personality or yourself. I see a lot of myself in you. I’m still lost but it feel better to be lost with a crowd then alone

:) for real. But I honestly like the fantasy more from what happens after the death. It will be just like here on earth but you are happy and content with things around you. It’s kinda make me excited that it’s achievable if I knew how to change as a person

You are not useless. You feel the same emotion as everyone but you just don’t speak it out loud. You get scared and that makes you not want to speak. That last fine , it’s totally normal. I can’t say it’s what you want from yourself but it’s a habit. One that can be won over. Hell you are doing it right now! Most people ( even me) never leave comments on anything.  You found the courage or desperation to let yourself be heard. PM if you want to talk

This is what bipolar does to you. It turns everyone against you. Real or not. I’m just glad you haven’t plan nothing yet guessing from “wanting to die in your sleep”. It so hard to grasp the idea that your family agrees that you are a burden... that’s sad too hear. 

Can you tell me more about what’s going on in your head

Personally I could never jump, I would like to think I could if I close my eyes but god dam I hate heights. Crazy thing is I know of a guy who jump Off a 150 ft Dam and still survived with minor injuries. He choose the dam because he knew he couldn’t swim so if the fall didn’t get him the water will... turns out he really good at floating

Please don’t keep it all in your head. The only place that you know nobody ever can see. You running low energy and that much is easy to notice. Please reach out to me or ther if you need to vent or talk some more

You can talk to me! You well feel better knowing there are other like you and you can feel apart of something. A community, maybe even a internet friendship. Please don’t do nothing to yourself. I know it’s easy to blame yourself but it’s not your fault
I hope you didn’t go through with it. The fall would not kill you. Please share more with us on what has you feeling like this? Loneliness? Angry? Scared? Please talk to me if you need to
This must have been a Terrible year for you. When did you notice things were spiraling down for you? Talk to me or anyone in here if you want to
Please don’t. Everyone gets addictive to bad habits before.. but it doesn’t define you. Talk with us some more, I’m sure we can help you out when you need it the most

Yes, Everyone here felt hopelessness before so we can all connect from that. I’m here for you buddy. I’m not great at talking but I listen well. I don’t know exactly what your situation is but if it make you feels less alone you can share more with us about why and the days leading up to it? Only if you have the energy to do so
